ai_summary: Agarwal Industrial Corporation Limited successfully held its 32nd Annual General Meeting, where shareholders approved the audited financial statements for FY2026, which were reported as free from any qualifications. A dividend of Rs. 3.30 per equity share was declared, and several strategic resolutions were passed, including omnibus approval for related party transactions and the adoption of new Main and Ancillary Objects for the company. There were no material red flags reported in the audit or secretarial reports.
